name: animation
description: Hand-drawn-style 2D animation as code, rendered in headless Chromium through a deterministic ink brush engine. The rotoscope skill copies a reference clip drawing by drawing: it traces each drawing to vector paths, renders them through the brush engine, measures every drawing against its source (XOR against a codec-noise floor, SSIM, paper colour), fits per-shot brush overrides kept in a tool-neutral override file, reviews 1:1 crops, and logs learnings that a retro step promotes into defaults. A shipped regression reproduces the shfred0 study at 239/239 drawings.
